## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm test:ui` (when editor behavior or rendering changed)
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm audit --audit-level high` (when dependencies changed)

## Review checklist

- [ ] The README or relevant docs are updated.
- [ ] New behavior has a focused regression test.
- [ ] No private campaign files, screenshots, generated assets, secrets, or API keys are included.
- [ ] Imported or demo assets have clear reuse rights and attribution.
- [ ] The change preserves the local-first and free project boundaries.
